headline: How to breed the Smoke Dragon
title: How to Breed Smoke Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends | Wind + Fire | DML Breeding Guide
video_script: Want the Smoke Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends? Breed two dragons that together carry the Wind and Fire elements. Careful, Wind and Fire can also give you the Bee Dragon, so you may need a few tries. Tip: higher level and rarer parents give you better odds of a rare dragon. Which dragon should I cover next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Higher level parents = better rare odds

description: Dragon Mania Legends: breed two dragons that together carry Wind and Fire to get the Smoke Dragon. No combination is guaranteed; the same elements can also give the Bee Dragon. Element combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay breeding guide.
